company.name: MindFort AI
company.shortDescription: Mindfort AI is an Autonomous AI Security Agent platform that perform continuous penetration testing of your attack surface at massive scale.
company.description: MindFort is an enterprise cybersecurity platform that uses AI agents to continuously test web apps for complex vulnerabilities. MindFort finds, validates, triages, and patches vulnerabilities, saving teams thousands of hours, hundreds of thousands of dollars, and streamlines compliance.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,451,514 to $10,038,339, a 1.56x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 53 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
